guidance: Sir, with respect to the guidance for FY27 on EBITDA, can you share how should one think on that?
While EBITDA margins are lower than last year, we expect them to be in a similar range as we currently are, around 7%, 8%.
capex: The Propel Points margin has normalized in the current range from the earlier quarter, which is Q1 of FY27, which had some spillover of overriding commissions and hence seemed elevated.
risks: These statements are not guarantee of future performance and involves risks and uncertainties that are difficult to predict.
The digitization of the process has helped them get near real-time visibility into their working capital, and instances of duplicate payments, delayed MSME payments have reduced considerably.
focus: We have also started taking customer advances from some of our new customers, which also had a positive impact on our operating cash flow.
